name: agents
description: Agents — the `llm` agent kind (an isolated LLM + tool loop in the background) and the roster of models agents may use. The four agent tools are core.
author: sapphire

agents.label: LLM agent
agents.description: a background LLM with tools that works a mission and reports back

spawn_schema.label: Toolset
spawn_schema.help: toolset name (default: the plugin's Default Toolset)

spawn_schema.label: Persona
spawn_schema.help: 'agent' = lean worker with no data scopes · 'self' = this chat's persona with her own memory (see memory) and nothing else · a persona name = that persona in full

spawn_schema.label: Memory (self only)
spawn_schema.help: prompt='self' only: false = identity alone · 'read-only' = search and read_self on this chat's memory scope · 'full' = save/update/delete too. Never a channel scope (email, bitcoin, calendar, chat apps).

app.label: Agents
app.description: Your agents by chat: progress, questions to answer, follow-ups, transcripts, and a form to spawn more
